title: Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice: cache only model-fixed prompt embeddings
summary: Prepare CustomVoice prompt embeddings directly, reusing fixed special-token and speaker/language prefixes while recomputing request-dependent text and instruction projections.

hardware: Ascend 910B1 source campaign; other devices require independent qualification
software: InferMatrixLab/qwen3-tts-engine source snapshot; consult source evidence for measured revisions
conditions: CustomVoice template and tokenizer behavior must match the inspected wrapper.
Model weights, device, dtype and speaker/language configuration stay fixed for the cache lifetime.

claims.description: CustomVoicePrompt caches special embeddings and prefixes keyed by normalized speaker and resolved language; it validates supported speakers/languages.
Request text and instruction projections are computed per call; returned trailing-text and pad embeddings are cloned.

downstream_impact: vLLM-Omni: first compare its processor output with the reference prompt builder. Reuse only fixed embeddings at the correct model owner.
Do not cache arbitrary request text or reuse prefixes across different models/adapters without identity and invalidation rules.
recommendations: Treat each mechanism as a separate transfer experiment; do not multiply isolated or combined-stack gains.
validation_plan: Compare full inputs_embeds, masks and generation kwargs against the reference for English, Chinese, auto language, dialect speakers and nonempty instructions.
Test repeated and changed text, mixed speakers and model reload; include unsupported-language and empty-input behavior.
Then validate generated audio and service TTFA under the frozen workload; prompt parity alone is not a service result.
limitations: This is a CustomVoice-specific template optimization, not a generic Qwen3-TTS task adapter.
Fixed-weight cache lifetime and hard-coded template slicing require revalidation after tokenizer or model updates.
Imported source guidance only; no InferRSI accelerator, audio-quality or end-to-end reproduction.
